content: Sirišṭir Šuru
Šurut maze Allaye asman edde zobin sirišṭi goijje.
Duniyai akarsara edde hali aššil, hiyanor uwore aššil andare guijja goin fani. Ar Allar Ruh fanir uwottu sola fira gorat aššil.
Toi Allaye hodde, "Fohor ok," henot fohor oiye.
Allaye sadde fohor bala oiye, toi Allaye fohorottu andarore zuda goijje.
Allaye fohorore nam diye "din," ar andarore hibaye nam diye "rait." Toi heṛe hazinna oiye edde binna oiye, ar hiyan aššilde foila din.
Allaye hodde, "Fanit maze ekkan gũitor ḍoil fák zaga ok, ar fani dui bag oi aleda ok."
Ei bafe Allaye fanit maze ekkan fák zaga goijje, nisor fani edde uworor fani aleda goijje. Ar henot hen oiye.
Bade Allaye he gũitor ḍoil fák zagaganor nam diye asman. Toi heṛe hazinna oiye edde binna oiye, ar hiyan aššilde dusora din.
Bade Allaye hodde, "Asmanor nisor hár fani ek zagat zoma ok, ar deha zok fuwana zaga." Ar henot hen oiye.
Allaye he fuwana zagar nam diye zobin, ar he fani zoma oiyede hiyanor nam diye doriya. Ar Allaye sadde hin bala oiye.
Allaye hodde, "Zobine háil ker, biz fodai gorede lota-fata, edde šobzi zar zar zat mozin dana loi gula dorade gula gas okkol, zobinor uwore fuṛaok." Ar henot hen oiye.
Toi zobine háil ker, biz fodai gorede lota-fata, edde šobzi zar zar zat mozin dana loi gula dorade gula gas okkol, fuṛaiye. Ar Allaye sadde hin bala oiye.
Toi heṛe hazinna oiye edde binna oiye, ar hiyan aššilde tisera din.
Bade Allaye hodde, "Raitottu dinore aleda goribolla asmanot gũitor ḍoil fák zagat fohor okkol ok, ar hin okkol sinno ok, boro din okkololla, din okkololla edde bosorolla,
ar hin okkole duniyait fohor dibolla asmanot gũitor ḍoil fák zagat takok." Ar henot hen oiye.
Toi Allaye dinor uwore razagiri goribolla ekkan beši ḍõr fohor, ar raitor uwore razagiri goribolla hiyanottuwaro ekka šoṛo fohor, ei beši ḍõr fohor duniyan edde tara banaiye.
Ar Allaye hinore asmanot gũitor ḍoil fák zagat buwaiye,
din edde raitor uwore razagiri goribolla, edde andarottu fohorore aleda goribolla. Ar Allaye sadde hin bala oiye.
Ar heṛe hazinna oiye edde binna oiye, ar hiyan aššilde sair lomboror din.
Bade Allaye hodde, "Fani nanan ḍoilla zandaror zãke bori uṛok, edde duniyair uwore asmanot maze faik okkol urok."
Toi Allaye doriyar he ḍõr ḍõr zanuwar okkol edde fanit zãk bandi solede nanan zator ze hár zandar okkol ase, hin okkolore, edde nanan zator faik okkol sirišti goijje. Ar Allaye sadde hin bala oiye.
Allaye hin okkolore duwa goijje, edde hodde, "Fólwala o edde beši o, ar doriyar fanire furon goro, duniyait faik okkol o beša beši ok."
Ar heṛe hazinna oiye edde binna oiye, ar hiyan aššilde faš lomboror din.
Tarfore Allaye hodde, "Zobinottu hár ḍoilla zandar zanuwar okkol niyoli aiyok: górot falede edde buke aṛede zandar, abanaiya fahari hár ḍoilla zandar okkol." Ar henot hen oiye.
Allaye zar zar zat mozin fahari zanuwar edde zar zar zat mozin górot falede zanuwar edde zar zar zat mozin zobinot hár ḍoilla buke aṛede zandar okkol banaiye. Ar Allaye sadde hin bala oiye.

Tarfore Allaye hodde, "Ãra ãrar súrot loi, ãrar ḍoilla manuš banai. Hitara doriyar mas, asmanor faik, górot falede edde fahari zanuwar, ar duniyair hár ḍoilla buke aṛede zandar okkolor uwore šašon goribo."

content.text: Toi Allaye manušore nizor súrote sirišti goijje,
maya edde morod gori hibaye hitarare sirišti goijje.

content: Allaye hitarare duwa goijje edde hitarare hodde, "Fólwala o edde zono šoinkaye beši o edde duniyai furon goro, ar duniyaire nizor šašonor tole ano. Ar doriyar mas okkol, asmanor tole faikor okkol, edde duniyair hár ḍoilla buke aṛede zandar okkolor uwore razagiri goro."
Tarfore Allaye hodde, "So, ãi duniyait asede hár ḍoilla biz fodai gorede lota-fata edde hár ḍoilla dana loi gula dorade gas okkol tũwarare dilam, hin okkol tũwarar haiddo oibo.
Ar duniyair hár zandar okkolore, asmanor uworor hár ḍoilla faik edde buke aṛede zandar okkolore, mani zeduggun zandar šiz ase hinolla adar hisabe hail fata gas gusola dilam." Ar henot hen oiye.
Toi Allaye hibar foida goijja hár kiššur uzu saiye, ar so, hin beši bala oiye. Toi hazinna oiye edde binna oiye, ar hiyan aššilde so lomboror din.
